item.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro Leads DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in Public Scores (Update)
item.description:
MiMo-V2.6-Pro Leads DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in Public Scores (Update)

MiMo-V2.6-Pro remains ahead of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in the latest public benchmark update (Oct 8 2026).

🔍 Overview

  • Rank says MiMo-V2.6-Pro is ahead.
  • Both of these models will change.
  • Only shared public evidence is shown.

📊 Scores & Rankings

  • MiMo-V2.6-Pro has the higher public point estimate, 74.11 versus 67.79 for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
  • MiMo-V2.6-Pro has the higher public coding point estimate, 64.6 to 62, with Supported evidence for both models.
  • Their conditional score ranges overlap, and these ranges do not establish rank confidence.
  • 10 results are shared.

💰 Cost Considerations

  • MiMo-V2.6-Pro has the lower estimated token cost for this stated workload.
  • DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has the lower estimated token cost for this stated workload.
  • Costs use the listed standard API rates.
  • Price, access, and your workload can each overturn that rank.

🛠️ Evidence Basis

  • Supported: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash · Estimated: MiMo-V2.6‑Pro.
  • Recommendations appear only when a shared evidence basis or an explicit operating constraint supports the call.
  • Category rows resting on Estimated evidence or different benchmark sets are marked directional and do not name a winner.
  • MiMo‑V2.6‑Pro is scored on Estimated evidence for agentic, so the reading is directional rather than like‑for‑like.
  • A row is like‑for‑like only when both scores rest on Supported evidence or the same weighted set.
  • Directional and not‑comparable rows remain visible, but they never receive a winner.

⚙️ Model Details

  • The documented context windows are equal.
  • Only shared benchmark results are displayed; positions use each benchmark’s normalized display scale when available.
  • Sparse evidence stays a ruled list rather than being closed into a radar shape.
  • Too few matched category axes support a radar.

📋 Summary Table

Model Public Point Estimate Public Coding Estimate Token‑Cost Claim (stated workload) Evidence Type
MiMo‑V2.6‑Pro 74.11 64.6 Lower (claim) Estimated (agentic), Supported (coding)
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 67.79 62 Lower (claim) Supported

📌 Additional Notes

  • Secondary and unsupported use cases stay disclosed below the initial list.
  • Rows that rest on Estimated evidence or different evidence sets are visible for coverage context but do not name a winner.
  • Each model page reports the same rank for the weighted public rows elsewhere.
